\section{Overview}

This report gives the results of the SPEC CPU2017 \ct{test} input (full simulations of every run)
with metric schema 10: spills are detected from runtime effective addresses
alone (runtime-detected stack store--load reuse, spill-like memory traffic;
\textit{derleyicinin spill kodu olmak zorunda de\u{g}il}). Every counter and
formula is defined in \ct{counter\_reference\_schema10.pdf}
(\ct{general\_reports/definitions/}). Data as of 2026-11-12 11:16.

The same program runs on five cache configurations of equal capacity (L1D
4~KiB, L2 32~KiB, 64~B lines); only the organisation changes. The L1I is the
same everywhere: 32 KiB, 2-way (256 sets), LRU.

\section{Program counters}

The program counters do not depend on the cache \trgloss{cache'ten ba\u{g}{\i}ms{\i}z}.
Tables 2 and 3 show the values of \ct{small-2way}. In 26 runs the counters are identical in all five configurations. In 8 runs (\ct{namd}, \ct{lbm}, \ct{imagick}, \ct{blender}, \ct{povray}, \ct{omnetpp}, \ct{wrf}, \ct{cam4}) they differ by at most 1.8e-05 of the instructions; no ratio of Table 3 moves by more than 0.001 percentage points, below the two decimals shown. The likely causes are the run paths, whose length depends on the configuration name and which the program sees in its arguments, and the simulated time that some programs read.

total & Sum over the completed runs (\textit{tamamlanan ko\c{s}ular{\i}n toplam{\i}}). \\
\end{tabularx}\par}

roi/total & \ct{roi\_total\_insts} / \ct{total\_insts}: share of the program that was measured (\textit{program{\i}n ne kadar{\i} \"ol\c{c}\"uld\"u}). \\
load/roi & \ct{roi\_load} / \ct{roi\_total\_insts}: loads among the ROI instructions (\textit{ROI komutlar{\i}n{\i}n y\"uzde ka\c{c}{\i} load}). \\
store/roi & \ct{roi\_store} / \ct{roi\_total\_insts}: stores among the ROI instructions (\textit{y\"uzde ka\c{c}{\i} store}). \\
spill/roi & (\ct{roi\_spill\_load} $+$ \ct{roi\_spill\_store}) / \ct{roi\_total\_insts}: \textbf{the main metric}, spill-like instructions (\textit{ana metrik: stack'e yazma veya stack'ten geri okuma pay{\i}}). \\
spill ld/load & \ct{roi\_spill\_load} / \ct{roi\_load}: loads that read a stack-written value back (\textit{load'lar{\i}n y\"uzde ka\c{c}{\i} stack'ten geri okuma}). \\
spill st/store & \ct{roi\_spill\_store} / \ct{roi\_store}: stores to the stack, read back or not (\textit{store'lar{\i}n y\"uzde ka\c{c}{\i} stack'e}). \\
spill ev/store & \ct{roi\_spill\_event} / \ct{roi\_store}: stores whose value is read later (\textit{store'lar{\i}n y\"uzde ka\c{c}{\i} sonra okunan de\u{g}er}). \\
spill ev/spill st & \ct{roi\_spill\_event} / \ct{roi\_spill\_store}: reuse rate of the stack writes (\textit{stack'e yaz{\i}lanlar{\i}n y\"uzde ka\c{c}{\i} geri kullan{\i}ld{\i}}). \\
spill/mem & (\ct{roi\_spill\_load} $+$ \ct{roi\_spill\_store}) / (\ct{roi\_load} $+$ \ct{roi\_store}): spill-like share of the memory instructions (\textit{bellek trafi\u{g}inin y\"uzde ka\c{c}{\i} spill-like}). \\
pooled & $\sum$ numerators $/ \sum$ denominators over the completed runs: large runs dominate (\textit{b\"ut\"un ko\c{s}ular birlikte; b\"uy\"uk ko\c{s}ular bask{\i}n}). \\
mean & Average of the per-run percentages: every run weighs the same (\textit{ko\c{s}u de\u{g}erlerinin ortalamas{\i}; her ko\c{s}u e\c{s}it a\u{g}{\i}rl{\i}kta}). \\
\end{tabularx}\par}


\section{Cache miss rates by configuration}

These depend on the configuration: the program and its instructions are the
same, only the hits and misses change \trgloss{konfig\"urasyona g\"ore de\u{g}i\c{s}ir}. An
\emph{access} is one request of a load or store to a cache; an instruction
that crosses a cache line makes two \trgloss{cache'e yap{\i}lan tek istek}. A
\emph{hit} ends at that level, a \emph{miss} goes one level down (L1D $\to$
L2 $\to$ DRAM). The caches are write-allocate: a store miss first fetches the
line. An L2 rate is \emph{local}: its denominator is the L1D misses of that
kind, not all accesses \trgloss{L2 oran{\i}n{\i}n paydas{\i} L1D miss'leridir}. Each of
Tables 4--8 is one configuration; the columns are the same in all of them.

L1D: all & L1D demand misses / L1D demand accesses: every load and store (\textit{b\"ut\"un load ve store'lar}). \\
spill ld & spill-load misses / spill-load accesses (\textit{spill load'lar}). \\
other ld & (\ct{ReadReq} misses $-$ spill-load misses) / (\ct{ReadReq} accesses $-$ spill-load accesses): the loads that are not spill loads (\textit{spill olmayan load'lar}); read it next to spill ld. \\
spill st & spill-store misses / spill-store accesses: every spill store (\textit{b\"ut\"un spill store'lar}). \\
spill ev. & spill-event misses / spill-event accesses: the spill stores read back (\textit{geri okunan spill store'lar}). \\
unread st & (spill-store $-$ spill-event misses) / (spill-store $-$ spill-event accesses): the spill stores never read back (\textit{hi\c{c} okunmayan spill store'lar}). \\
other st & (\ct{WriteReq} misses $-$ spill-store misses) / (\ct{WriteReq} accesses $-$ spill-store accesses): the stores that are not spill stores (\textit{spill olmayan store'lar}). \\
L2 local: all & L2 demand misses / L2 demand accesses: the L1D and L1I misses together (\textit{L2'ye gelen b\"ut\"un istekler}). \\
L2 local: the rest & The same kinds at L2; the denominator is that kind's L1D misses, so it can be small: read it with care (\textit{payda o t\"ur\"un L1D miss'leri; k\"u\c{c}\"uk olabilir}). \\
pooled & $\sum$ numerators $/ \sum$ denominators over the completed runs: large runs dominate (\textit{b\"ut\"un ko\c{s}ular birlikte; b\"uy\"uk ko\c{s}ular bask{\i}n}). \\
mean & Average of the per-run percentages: every run weighs the same (\textit{ko\c{s}u de\u{g}erlerinin ortalamas{\i}; her ko\c{s}u e\c{s}it a\u{g}{\i}rl{\i}kta}). \\
\textemdash & Run not finished, or no access of that kind (\textit{bitmemi\c{s} ko\c{s}u ya da o t\"urde access yok}). \\
\end{tabularx}\par}

L1D: all & L1D demand misses / L1D demand accesses: every load and store (\textit{b\"ut\"un load ve store'lar}). \\
spill ld & spill-load misses / spill-load accesses (\textit{spill load'lar}). \\
other ld & (\ct{ReadReq} misses $-$ spill-load misses) / (\ct{ReadReq} accesses $-$ spill-load accesses): the loads that are not spill loads (\textit{spill olmayan load'lar}); read it next to spill ld. \\
spill st & spill-store misses / spill-store accesses: every spill store (\textit{b\"ut\"un spill store'lar}). \\
spill ev. & spill-event misses / spill-event accesses: the spill stores read back (\textit{geri okunan spill store'lar}). \\
unread st & (spill-store $-$ spill-event misses) / (spill-store $-$ spill-event accesses): the spill stores never read back (\textit{hi\c{c} okunmayan spill store'lar}). \\
other st & (\ct{WriteReq} misses $-$ spill-store misses) / (\ct{WriteReq} accesses $-$ spill-store accesses): the stores that are not spill stores (\textit{spill olmayan store'lar}). \\
L2 local: all & L2 demand misses / L2 demand accesses: the L1D and L1I misses together (\textit{L2'ye gelen b\"ut\"un istekler}). \\
L2 local: the rest & The same kinds at L2; the denominator is that kind's L1D misses, so it can be small: read it with care (\textit{payda o t\"ur\"un L1D miss'leri; k\"u\c{c}\"uk olabilir}). \\
pooled & $\sum$ numerators $/ \sum$ denominators over the completed runs: large runs dominate (\textit{b\"ut\"un ko\c{s}ular birlikte; b\"uy\"uk ko\c{s}ular bask{\i}n}). \\
mean & Average of the per-run percentages: every run weighs the same (\textit{ko\c{s}u de\u{g}erlerinin ortalamas{\i}; her ko\c{s}u e\c{s}it a\u{g}{\i}rl{\i}kta}). \\
\textemdash & Run not finished, or no access of that kind (\textit{bitmemi\c{s} ko\c{s}u ya da o t\"urde access yok}). \\
\end{tabularx}\par}

{\footnotesize\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.0}
\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{27mm} >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}X@{}}
L1D: all & L1D demand misses / L1D demand accesses: every load and store (\textit{b\"ut\"un load ve store'lar}). \\
spill ld & spill-load misses / spill-load accesses (\textit{spill load'lar}). \\
other ld & (\ct{ReadReq} misses $-$ spill-load misses) / (\ct{ReadReq} accesses $-$ spill-load accesses): the loads that are not spill loads (\textit{spill olmayan load'lar}); read it next to spill ld. \\
spill st & spill-store misses / spill-store accesses: every spill store (\textit{b\"ut\"un spill store'lar}). \\
spill ev. & spill-event misses / spill-event accesses: the spill stores read back (\textit{geri okunan spill store'lar}). \\
unread st & (spill-store $-$ spill-event misses) / (spill-store $-$ spill-event accesses): the spill stores never read back (\textit{hi\c{c} okunmayan spill store'lar}). \\
other st & (\ct{WriteReq} misses $-$ spill-store misses) / (\ct{WriteReq} accesses $-$ spill-store accesses): the stores that are not spill stores (\textit{spill olmayan store'lar}). \\
L2 local: all & L2 demand misses / L2 demand accesses: the L1D and L1I misses together (\textit{L2'ye gelen b\"ut\"un istekler}). \\
L2 local: the rest & The same kinds at L2; the denominator is that kind's L1D misses, so it can be small: read it with care (\textit{payda o t\"ur\"un L1D miss'leri; k\"u\c{c}\"uk olabilir}). \\
pooled & $\sum$ numerators $/ \sum$ denominators over the completed runs: large runs dominate (\textit{b\"ut\"un ko\c{s}ular birlikte; b\"uy\"uk ko\c{s}ular bask{\i}n}). \\
mean & Average of the per-run percentages: every run weighs the same (\textit{ko\c{s}u de\u{g}erlerinin ortalamas{\i}; her ko\c{s}u e\c{s}it a\u{g}{\i}rl{\i}kta}). \\
\textemdash & Run not finished, or no access of that kind (\textit{bitmemi\c{s} ko\c{s}u ya da o t\"urde access yok}). \\
\end{tabularx}\par}

\section{Comparison of two benchmarks}

To make the tables concrete, this page follows two benchmarks through the five
configurations \trgloss{iki benchmark'{\i}n konfig\"urasyonlar boyunca
kar\c{s}{\i}la\c{s}t{\i}rmas{\i}}. By spill share (\ct{spill/roi}) \ct{cactuBSSN} ranks
1st and \ct{parest} 33rd of the 34 completed runs of the
\ct{test} input. The rows of the cache tables go
from the least to the most associative; the last row is the change from
direct-mapped to fully associative, in percentage points
\trgloss{y\"uzde puan fark{\i}}.

\textbf{Reading} \trgloss{okumas{\i}}:
\begin{itemize}
\setlength{\itemsep}{1pt}\setlength{\topsep}{2pt}
\item \textbf{Program.} \ct{cactuBSSN} spends 33.48\% of its ROI instructions on spill-like traffic, \ct{parest} 2.13\%. That is 82.88\% of the memory instructions of \ct{cactuBSSN} and 6.14\% of those of \ct{parest} (\textit{bellek trafi\u{g}indeki spill pay{\i}}). These values are the same in every configuration.
\item \textbf{Spill loads against other loads.} Over the five configurations the spill loads of \ct{cactuBSSN} miss L1D 7.84--8.98\% of the time, its other loads 51.27--62.01\%; for \ct{parest} 0.59--9.23\% and 10.96--16.72\% (\textit{spill load'lar di\u{g}er load'lardan daha az miss ediyor mu?}).
\item \textbf{Associativity.} From \ct{dm} to \ct{fa} the spill-load miss rate of \ct{cactuBSSN} goes 8.49\% $\to$ 8.98\%: it hardly changes with the organisation, which points to capacity rather than conflict misses (\textit{\c{c}ak{\i}\c{s}ma de\u{g}il kapasite miss'leri}). That of \ct{parest} goes 9.23\% $\to$ 0.59\%: it falls sharply with associativity: in the direct-mapped cache these are mostly conflict misses (\textit{\c{c}o\u{g}u \c{c}ak{\i}\c{s}ma miss'i}). The overall L1D miss rate goes 17.36\% $\to$ 15.22\% for \ct{cactuBSSN} and 15.36\% $\to$ 9.72\% for \ct{parest}.
\item \textbf{Weight of the spill traffic.} Spill loads and spill stores make 82.9\% of the L1D accesses of \ct{cactuBSSN} but 38.0--45.2\% of its L1D misses; for \ct{parest} 6.1\% of the accesses and 0.4--3.4\% of the misses (\textit{spill trafi\u{g}inin access'ler ve miss'ler i\c{c}indeki pay{\i}}).
\item \textbf{L2.} Of the accesses that miss L1D, L2 misses 48.80--65.69\% for \ct{cactuBSSN} and 47.58--68.60\% for \ct{parest}; the spill loads that reach L2 miss there 15.26--16.58\% and 2.53--15.87\%.
\end{itemize}
